baseline_rule: 30s companion-only before and after each loaded block; median of two p95 values, same image/period. Preserve drift; no adjusted post-hoc threshold.
relative_rule: Compare each fixed run to native run within the same block; all absolute and relative gates must pass in every planned replicate.
stop_rule: Complete a begun paired block including its after-reference; if any acquisition, fixed accounting or practical gate fails, stop subsequent blocks and E4-E6. No acceptance reruns. If all blocks pass, assess representation and determine further acquisition before probability work.
data_role: Exploratory pilot only; no final holdout or acceptance of probability assumptions
clock_uncertainty: deadline equality uses recorded integer ns; no proved clock uncertainty bound
scope: Two sequences and distinct predeclared segments; do not infer road-driving validation or universal software applicability
segment_note: Offset is before initialization; evaluated frame starts depend on initialization. Record actual frame range; segments are not guaranteed independent.
continuation_rule: Insufficient coverage triggers E3 design/collection, not automatic termination. A substantive failed gate stops downstream validation and triggers diagnosis; failed data retained.
